title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR BOVINE BREEDING (REGULATION OF PRODUCTION, SALE OF BOVINE SEMEN AND ARTIFICIAL INSEMINATION SERVICES) ACT, 2018
full_text: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR BOVINE BREEDING (REGULATION OF PRODUCTION, SALE OF BOVINE SEMEN AND ARTIFICIAL INSEMINATION SERVICES) ACT, 2018 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201851 Act Number: 51 Enactment Date: 2018-12-16 Act Year: 2018 Short Title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR BOVINE BREEDING (REGULATION OF PRODUCTION, SALE OF BOVINE SEMEN AND ARTIFICIAL INSEMINATION SERVICES) ACT, 2018 Long Title: An Act to regulate bovine breeding activities including use of bovine breeding bulls for production of bovine semen, production, processing, storage, sale and distribution of bovine semen, and artificial insemination services in bovines for improving the productivity of bovines in the *State of and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
